tasks.description: In docs/content/docs/dev/datastream/operators/asyncio.md, under the 'Retry Support' section, document the new built-in Python predicate helpers (empty_result_predicate, has_exception_predicate, exception_type_predicate) from pyflink.datastream.async_retry_predicates, explaining what each matches and how to use them with AsyncRetryPredicate/AsyncRetryStrategy.

Mirror the new built-in Python retry predicate helper documentation in docs/content.zh/docs/dev/datastream/operators/asyncio.md under the '重试支持' section, describing empty_result_predicate, has_exception_predicate, and exception_type_predicate.

In docs/content/docs/dev/datastream/operators/asyncio.md 'Retry Support' section, note that AsyncRetryPredicate and AsyncRetryStrategy interface methods are abstract, so custom subclasses must implement all of them or instantiation raises TypeError.

branches.question: Does the Python datastream documentation describe async retry predicates/strategies and where would new built-in predicate helpers be documented?

Does the Python asyncio docs page (or a Python-specific async I/O page) document retry predicates/strategies and where would the new built-in predicate helpers be surfaced?
Is async_retry_predicates exported in pyflink.datastream __init__ and referenced anywhere in docs, indicating a public API surface needing documentation?
